nodes.description: Immutable owner address set in the constructor; gates houseJoinGame, houseReveal and destruct
mapping(uint176 => uint232) packing status and player2 per game id
mapping(uint176 => bytes32) commitment hashes per game id slot
mapping(uint176 => uint) revealed and verified numbers per game id slot
msg.sender: untrusted caller used for identity, ownership checks and hash commitments
constructor: sets OWNER_ADDRESS to msg.sender
createGame: payable game creation, derives id from sender and wager, stores hash
joinGame: second player joins by matching wager and storing commitment hash
houseJoinGame: owner stores house hash and advances status to 3
reveal: player reveals N, verifies commitment hash and records verified number
houseReveal: owner reveals house number, computes randomness, deletes state and pays out
encodeGameID: packs player1 address and wager into a uint176 game id
decodeGameID: unpacks player1 address and wager from a uint176 game id
encodeGameData: packs status and player2 into a uint232 game record
decodeGameData: unpacks status and player2 from a uint232 game record
getGameData: public view reading games/playerHashes and decoding GameData
getHash: keccak256(abi.encodePacked(msg.sender, N)) commitment helper
cancelGame: player cancels a game, refunds both sides and charges owner fee
destruct: owner-only selfdestruct of the contract
selfdestruct(payable(OWNER_ADDRESS)) destroys contract and forwards balance
payable(g.p1 or g.p2).transfer(payout): ETH payout sent to user-controlled winner address
payable(OWNER_ADDRESS).transfer(fee): ETH house fee transfer
Multiple payable(...).transfer(...) refunds in cancelGame to user-controlled addresses
payout = g.wager * 2; fee = payout * 3 / 100; payout -= fee (uint arithmetic on wager/fee)
